Brake & Electronic Sway Control.name: 12" Drum with Bosch ABS & Sway Control
Disc Brakes (Tandem Axle with 1600PSI Actuator & Breakaway) No DSC

Chassis Finish.name: Toughcoat Powder-coated in Black
Chassis Finish.description: Powder-coated steel offers several advantages over painted steel. It provides a more durable and long-lasting finish, as the powder coating is highly resistant to scratches, chips, and corrosion. This makes it ideal for outdoor and high-traffic applications. Additionally, powder coating creates a thicker and more uniform layer, ensuring consistent coverage and protection. Overall, powder-coated steel requires less maintenance and offers superior protection, making it a better choice for many applications.

Chassis Finish.name: X-Guard Rubbercoat
Chassis Finish.description: The ultimate coating for your chassis. This creates a thick, tough rubberised coating that bonds, providing excellent protection from corrosion and rocks in all environments.

Chassis Finish.name: Hot Dip Galvanised
Chassis Finish.description: Hot dip galvanizing is a process where steel components of a caravan, such as the chassis, are immersed in molten zinc. This creates a thick, tough metallic zinc coating that bonds metallurgically to the steel base, providing excellent protection from corrosion in normal environments. This process ensures long-term durability and resistance to harsh conditions, making it a trusted solution for enhancing the longevity of caravans.

Frame.name: SPR Aluminium Frame
Frame.description: Aluminium Wall framing option utilising 25mm C-Channel Sections with Henrob Self Piercing Solid Rivets.

Hitch type.name: DO35 by Cruisemaster Recessed
Hitch type.description: The Cruisemaster DO35 is a high-articulation off-road coupling designed for superior towing performance and safety. The DO35 coupling allows for easy hitching with its patented drop-on design, ensuring secure attachment even in challenging terrains. It also includes a positive locking mechanism with a Check lock cap to keep dirt out and indicate secure attachment. This coupling is ideal for off-road caravans, providing enhanced manoeuvrability and stability.

Hitch type.name: DO45 by Cruisemaster Recessed & 4.5T Chains
Hitch type.description: The Cruisemaster DO45 hitch is a premium heavy-duty towing solution designed for serious off-road and touring enthusiasts. With a massive 4.5-tonne rating and full 360  articulation, it provides exceptional stability and maneuverability over rough terrain. Its dual locking mechanism and patented  Checklock  cap enhance safety by ensuring a secure connection every time. Built tough for Australian conditions, the DO45 is ideal for those who demand reliability, strength, and performance when towing large caravans.

Jockey Wheel.name: BOS 3 Rib Jockey Unit With Plate & Extension
Trail-A-Mate MKII Blue With 60mm Clamp & Wheel (Fitted)
Jockey Wheel.description: The Trail-A-Mate MKII Blue with 60mm Clamp & Wheel offers several benefits, making it a versatile and convenient choice for caravan owners. This hydraulic jack doubles as a jockey wheel, providing easy lifting and manoeuvring of your caravan with minimal effort. The 60mm clamp ensures a secure fit, enhancing stability and safety.

Stabilising Legs.name: BOS Corner Jacks / Stabilisers, 600mm (2 each set, 2 sets)
Stabilising Legs.description: The BOS Corner Jacks / Stabilisers, 600mm, offer several benefits for caravan owners. These stabilisers are powerful enough to lift your van or trailer off the ground, making it easy to change a flat tyre or insert wheel supports. They can be operated easily by hand or with a cordless drill, thanks to the patented BOS gearbox. The unique BOS PUSH/PULL Handle makes release and positioning straightforward. Additionally, the large base plate can be angled and rotated for maximum stability, and extensions are available for extra height when needed. These features make the BOS Corner Jacks / Stabilisers a practical and reliable choice for ensuring your caravan or trailer remains stable and secure.

Stabilising Legs.name: BOS Corner Jacks / Stabilisers, 700mm (2 each set, 2 sets)
Stabilising Legs.description: The BOS Corner Jacks / Stabilisers, 700mm, offers extra length / height compared to the 500mm.  Both offer several benefits for caravan owners. These stabilisers are powerful enough to lift your van or trailer off the ground, making it easy to change a flat tyre or insert wheel supports. They can be operated easily by hand or with a cordless drill, thanks to the patented BOS gearbox. The unique BOS PUSH/PULL Handle makes release and positioning straightforward. Additionally, the large base plate can be angled and rotated for maximum stability, and extensions are available for extra height when needed. These features make the BOS Corner Jacks / Stabilisers a practical and reliable choice for ensuring your caravan or trailer remains stable and secure.

Stone guard.name: Stone Guard in Aluminium
Stone guard.description: A caravan aluminium stone guard provides robust protection against stones and debris, preventing damage to the front of your caravan and reducing the risk of costly repairs. The aluminium material is durable and lightweight, ensuring long-lasting performance without adding significant weight. Additionally, it helps shield storage boxes, and other items mounted at the front of your caravan. This protector enhances the overall safety and longevity of your caravan, making your travels more worry-free.

Suspension.name: 3.0T Cruisemaster ATX Coil S/A
Suspension.description: The Cruisemaster ATX 3.0T Coil Suspension is a premium off-road suspension system designed for serious touring and rugged terrain. Its heavy-duty construction supports up to 3.0 tonnes per axle, offering exceptional durability and reliability. The coil spring setup, combined with high-performance monotube dampers, delivers a smooth and controlled ride, even in challenging conditions.

Suspension.name: 3.0T Cruisemaster ATX Lvl 3 Manual S/A
Suspension.description: The Cruisemaster ATX 3.0T Level 3 Manual Suspension System offers a premium off-road experience with precise manual control over ride height and leveling. Designed for serious adventurers, the Level 3 manual system allows users to manually adjust the suspension height at each corner, making it ideal for uneven campsites or load balancing. Paired with the robust ATX 3.0T coil setup, it delivers exceptional durability, ride comfort, and handling across tough terrain. This system is perfect for those who want the flexibility of air suspension control without relying on full automation or electronics.

Suspension.name: 3.3T Cruisemaster CRS2 Country Road (Inc. 10" Drum Brakes)
3.5T Cruisemaster CRS2 Country Road (Inc. 12" Drum Brakes)
Suspension.description: The 3.5T Cruisemaster CRS2 Country Road (Inc. 12" Drum Brakes) is a semi-off-road suspension system that provides the quality ride characteristics of an independent arm suspension in a lighter weight package, making it ideal for those who travel on both paved and unpaved roads. The inclusion of 12" drum brakes ensures reliable stopping power, enhancing safety during travel. Additionally, the CRS2 has been developed based on real-world testing and customer feedback, ensuring it meets the needs of modern caravanners. Overall, the CRS2 offers a balanced combination of performance, durability, and safety for a comfortable and secure journey.

Suspension.name: 4.5T Cruisemaster XT Coil
Suspension.description: The 4.5T Cruisemaster XT Coil suspension system provides excellent ride characteristics with its heavy-duty shock absorbers, ensuring superior damping control in both bump and rebound directions. The system s independent A-frame design reduces unsprung weight, enhancing stability and handling. Additionally, it features adjustable toe and camber settings, allowing for precise wheel alignment. The Cruisemaster XT Coil is also low maintenance, thanks to its polyurethane bushes and steel sleeves in all moving parts. Overall, it delivers a smoother, more controlled ride, making it ideal for all-terrain adventures.

Suspension.name: 4.5T Cruisemaster XT Level 3 Manual
Suspension.description: The 4.5T Cruisemaster XT Level 3 provides exceptional ride quality and stability, thanks to its independent suspension design and heavy-duty shock absorbers. The system allows for manual adjustment of ride height, which is particularly useful for varying load conditions and terrain. Additionally, it features low maintenance requirements with polyurethane bushes and steel sleeves in all moving parts. This suspension system enhances overall handling and safety, making it ideal for both on-road and off-road adventures.

Suspension.name: 4.5T Cruisemaster XT Level 5 BCS
Suspension.description: The new Cruisemaster BCS is the Body Control System is an advanced airbag controller that will horizon level your caravan at the push of a button, and will also automatically go to ride height when you're ready to leave your destination.

Suspension.name: 4.5T Tuff-Ride L3 Wireless
Suspension.description: The 4.5T Tuff-Ride L3 Wireless suspension is designed for superior off-road performance, offering independent coil suspension for enhanced stability and ride comfort. It provides excellent ground clearance, making it ideal for rough terrains. The system is sway control ready, ensuring safer towing. Additionally, airbag suspension upgrades allow for customizable ride height, adapting to different conditions.

Wheels & Tyres.name: Toro 16" 285/75R16 Yokohama AT 126 Index 6x139 ET0 (3.0T)
Wheels & Tyres.description: MPC Toro wheel with Yokohama tyres offers a great balance of off-road capability and load support. Their larger diameter improves ground clearance, making them ideal for rough terrain, while the wider tread enhances traction and stability. The taller sidewalls also help absorb shocks, providing a smoother ride when towing caravans.

Wheels & Tyres.name: ROH Black 17" 265/70R17 Yokohama AT-X 5x150 or 6x139
Wheels & Tyres.description: The ROH Black 17" wheels fitted with 265/70R17 Yokohama AT-X tyres, available in 5x150 or 6x139 stud patterns, offer a rugged and stylish solution for off-road and touring setups. This combination provides excellent ground clearance and a wide footprint for enhanced traction and stability on varied terrain. The all-terrain Yokohama AT-X tyres are engineered for durability and comfort, making them ideal for both highway cruising and off-road adventures. These wheels are a great fit for vehicles requiring strength, performance, and a bold aesthetic.

TV.name: 32" Smart TV
TV.description: 80cm widescreen HD luxury on the go with the ENGLAON LED32M80. This 32  LED TV features a built-in DVD player, Chromecast, Google TV, and Bluetooth for endless on-demand entertainment anywhere.

Wifi.name: RV Wi-Fi with 5G router
Wifi.description: RV Wi-Fi provides a reliable internet connection for caravans, ensuring you stay connected even in remote locations. It typically includes a router and external antenna to boost signal strength, allowing for seamless streaming, browsing, and communication on the go12. With options for 4G and 5G connectivity, RV Wi-Fi systems are designed to handle the demands of modern travelers, making it easier to work, stay in touch, and enjoy entertainment while on the road.

Wifi.name: Cowfish 5G Wi-Fi
Wifi.description: The Cowfish VanConnect 5G Wi-Fi system is designed specifically for caravans providing fast and reliable internet connectivity on the go. It utilizes advanced 5G technology with 4x4 MU-MIMO (Multiple User, Multiple Input, Multiple Output) to deliver high-speed internet across multiple devices12. The system is compatible with all major Australian data providers and can switch seamlessly between 5G and 4G LTE-Advanced when necessary.

Awning.description: Carefree's Freedom Electric Awning with Bluetooth Motion Sensing will self retract if it gets too windy.

Slide-out Kitchen.name: K4 Weber BBQ Provision & Sink - Black
Slide-out Kitchen.description: A versatile slide-out kitchen with sink, plumbed Hot and Cold mixer tap and BBQ provision that  is compact and lightweight for those that love to entertain.

Slide-out Kitchen.name: K5i Weber BBQ Provision, Sink & Portable Induction - Black
Slide-out Kitchen.description: A complete slide-out kitchen with sink, plumbed Hot and Cold mixer tap, BBQ provision and additional bench space that can be used as a preparation area or for cooking those tasty side dishes on the supplied single hob portable induction cooktop.

Slide-out Kitchen.name: Slide Out Tray 800mm
Slide-out Kitchen.description: A lightweight compact slide-out aluminium tray that can be used for storage, food preparation or as a BBQ table.

Slide-out Kitchen.name: Slide Out Tray 1200mm
Slide-out Kitchen.description: A long slide-out aluminium tray that can be used for storage, food preparation or as a BBQ table.

Slide-out Kitchen.name: Slide Out Drawer / Tub 1200mm
Slide-out Kitchen.description: A great storage solution that sides out so you can get your items out without having to reach into your tunnel boot

Dust Reduction.name: CS Pressure - 12v Powered Dust Reduction
Dust Reduction.description: The CS Pressure - 12V Powered Dust Reduction system keeps your caravan clean and dust-free, especially during off-road travels. This system creates positive pressure inside the caravan, effectively blocking dust from entering through windows, doors, and vents. The energy-efficient 12V fan minimizes power consumption while providing robust dust reduction. Built to withstand harsh conditions, the CS Pressure system is durable and reliable, making it an ideal choice for maintaining a comfortable and clean living space on the go.

Kitchen Extras.name: 1 x Additional Black Picnic Table (Where possible)
Kitchen Extras.description: Two picnic tables for extra space to hold appliances or other items.

Entry Door.name: Black Entry Door 1822x622
Entry Door.description: The Aussie Traveller caravan entry door is designed for durability, security, and convenience. It features a three-point locking system for enhanced safety, a UV-stabilised acrylic window for added protection, and a security screen with fly mesh to keep insects out while allowing ventilation. All the clever features of the Aussie traveller entry door but with an additional 72mm height increase taking it to 1822mm makes it ideal for taller people

Entry Door.name: White Dometic CaraD Door 1850x622
Entry Door.description: The Dometic CaraD entry door offers a blend of security, durability, and convenience for caravans. It features a four-point locking system for enhanced safety, a highly resistant safety mesh tested to withstand strong impacts, and tinted safety glass for privacy. The integrated blind system allows for sun protection and added comfort, while the secure latching mechanism ensures stability during travel.

Gas.name: 2 x Gas Bayonets Plus 1 x Cold Tap At Tunnel Boot
1 x Gas Bayonet Plus 1 x Cold & 1 x Hot Taps At Tunnel Boot
2 x Gas Bayonets Plus 1 x Cold & 1 x Hot Taps At Tunnel Boot

Cooling.name: Sirocco Fan (Each)
Cooling.description: Sirocco fans  provide superior air circulation, ensuring a comfortable temperature throughout the space. They are energy-efficient, consuming less power and thus extending battery life, which is crucial for off-grid adventures. Additionally, Sirocco fans operate quietly, maintaining a peaceful environment.

Fridge.name: 274L Thetford Compressor Fridge ( with BF electrical systems)
Fridge.description: The Thetford fridge offers an impressive 274 litres of storage, significantly more than the Dometic fridge options. This extra space is perfect for longer trips or larger families. With day and night modes for customizable cooling, it helps manage energy consumption effectively.

Heating.name: Diesel Heater
Heating.description: The Webasto diesel heater is a versatile and efficient heating solution for caravans. It offers rapid and consistent heating with a heat output of up to 2 kW, ensuring comfort in various environments. The heater is fuel-efficient, consuming as little as 0.11-0.23 litres per hour, and operates quietly, making it ideal for maintaining a comfortable atmosphere without excessive noise. Its compact design allows for flexible installation options, including underfloor or onboard setups. Additionally, it features easy maintenance and full diagnostics, ensuring reliable performance and minimal downtime.

Heating.name: Truma Gas Heater
Heating.description: The Truma gas heater is a reliable and efficient heating solution for caravans. It offers quick and effective heating with a high thermal output, ensuring comfort even in cold weather. The heater is energy-efficient, consuming minimal gas while providing consistent warmth. Its compact design allows for easy installation in tight spaces, and it operates quietly, enhancing the overall comfort of your living space. Additionally, the Truma gas heater features auto-ignition and can be used with optional fan kits for improved air circulation.

Heating.name: Hydronic Diesel Hot Water Service & Heater in One ("Gasless" Interior Option)
Heating.description: The Hydronic Diesel Hot Water System (HWS) & Heater offers a versatile and efficient solution for caravans by providing rapid hot water and air heating, ensuring comfort in the coldest conditions. The system is fuel-efficient, using diesel, which eliminates the need for LPG, and it heats up quickly with minimal noise.

Hot Water.name: Endless / Fogatti Instant Hot Water (Gas)
Hot Water.description: The Endless Instant Hot Water system provides unlimited hot water on demand, ensuring you never run out during showers or heavy usage. Its energy-efficient design heats water only when needed, leading to significant energy savings compared to traditional tank water heaters. Additionally, it offers consistent water temperature.

Hot Water.name: Hydronic Diesel Hot Water Service "Gasless"
Hot Water.description: The Hydronic diesel hot water system offers fast hot water even in the coldest conditions, all in a super robust form. It eliminates the hassles, risks and costs associated with LPG. Powered by the latest HS3 furnace from Eberspacher, it is the quietest, most robust, and versatile system ever.

Cabinetry.name: Pull-Out Coffee Machine Tray in Pantry
Cabinetry.description: A pull-out coffee machine tray allows for a dedicated spot for your coffee maker in your caravan. The tray allows for easy access and use of the coffee machine, reducing the need to lift and move heavy appliances and keeps your benchtop space clutter-free. Tray dimensions are 575 (L) X 272.5 (W).

Cabinetry.name: Pull Out Kitchen Dual Bins
Cabinetry.description: The Pull-Out Kitchen Dual Bins 2 x 20L maximize space in your caravan by providing separate compartments for waste and recycling and help to keep the kitchen area organized and clean. The soft-close mechanism ensures smooth and quiet operation, preventing slamming and reducing wear and tear. Additionally, the pull-out design allows for easy access and disposal, enhancing convenience and efficiency during your travels.

Bathroom.name: OGO Composting Toilet
Bathroom.description: The OGO composting toilet is an excellent choice for off-grid living and eco-conscious users. It features an electric agitator that simplifies waste mixing, ensuring effective breakdown and odour prevention with just the push of a button. The compact, sleek design fits well in small spaces like caravans. Additionally, the OGO toilet separates liquids from solids, reducing odours and making maintenance easier. Its waterless operation conserves water, making it an environmentally friendly option.

Reversing camera.name: Twin Lens Car Windscreen Monitor
Reversing camera.description: The twin lens car windscreen monitor significantly enhances driving safety by providing a comprehensive view of the road. Its dual-camera system captures both wide-angle and telephoto perspectives, enabling early detection of potential hazards such as vehicles, pedestrians, and lane departures. This advanced monitoring helps in preventing accidents through features like lane keeping assist, adaptive cruise control, and automatic emergency braking. Additionally, it improves night vision, making driving in low-light conditions safer and more secure. Overall, the system offers a safer and more confident driving experience.

Reversing camera.name: Twin Lens Rearview Mirror Monitor
Reversing camera.description: The twin lens rear view mirror monitor enhances vehicle safety by providing clear and comprehensive rear visibility. This system includes a 45-degree camera for general rearview and a 120-degree camera for reversing, ensuring a wide field of view. It helps drivers reverse and park with confidence, reducing the risk of accidents and making manoeuvring in tight spaces easier. Additionally, the monitor clips over the existing rearview mirror, offering a seamless integration without obstructing the driver's view.

Tracking GPS/anti-theft.name: WiTi / RV Secure with Alarm & GPS
Tracking GPS/anti-theft.description: The WiTi with Alarm & GPS system integrates advanced GPS tracking and alarm functionalities, providing real-time location tracking and instant alerts in case of theft or unauthorized movement. The GPS feature ensures you can monitor your caravan from anywhere, while the alarm system deters potential thieves and alerts you immediately if any suspicious activity is detected.
